//: The root manifest exists so a host can IDENTIFY this repo. Every
runtime detector -- Replit's, Nixpacks, Render's, Heroku's -- decides
'this is a Node project' by finding a package.json at the root. This
repo had 36 of them, one per app, and none here, so importers saw a
directory of shell scripts and refused to classify it. That was a real
failure: a correct, tested ecosystem that a PaaS could not recognise.
NO dependencies, deliberately. gateway.js requires only node:http,
node:fs and node:path. Adding a dependency here would mean a root
node_modules that shadows nothing and confuses install-ecosystem.sh.
NO workspaces, deliberately. Each of the 36 apps carries its own
package.json AND its own package-lock.json, and install-ecosystem.sh
installs them separately on purpose -- npm workspaces would hoist and
re-resolve all of it, invalidating 36 lockfiles that the Docker path
and CI both depend on being exact.
NO postinstall, deliberately. Installing 36 apps is a two-minute
operation and must be something a person asks for, not a side effect
of `npm install`. deploy/replit-boot.sh calls it when it is needed.
name: vaco
description: 36 applications -- 34 Node/Express backends and two Vite frontends -- sharing a ledger, a session service, an identity service and an analytics spine, served behind a single-port gateway.
